data.content_ref: inline:Suspended nodes should be re-examinable only through a fresh edge-construction pass that commits new warrants — never by relabeling an existing graph. Conjecture: pass-composition is associative and idempotent, so the overall process remains deterministic (each pass is a fresh unique fixpoint) and polynomial (passes are independent); root validity is preserved because the only route to a status change is a new committed warrant, which is exactly what a new pass adds.
